explanation: Such an r has h_r outside the span of the later functionals: precomposition with L_r is linear (LinearMap.lcomp) and kills the span of the later h_t, but not h_r. The fresh functionals (outside the span of the later ones) are linearly independent (a vanishing combination with a nonzero coefficient would express the first such functional through later ones), hence at most finrank (Dual K V) = finrank V of them (Subspace.dual_finrank_eq).
